title: 🚨 MOST PEOPLE SAY THEY HAVE FAITH…
paragraphs:
🚨 MOST PEOPLE SAY THEY HAVE FAITH…
…but their life never changes.
Let’s be honest.

You say you trust God…
but you keep delaying obedience.
You hear the Word…
but you don’t act on it.

That’s not faith.
That’s comfort disguised as belief.
And it’s keeping you stuck.
(For serious believers only)
This is not a motivational read.
This is a wake-up call.

This book will confront the lie that you can believe in God…
without actually following Him.

It will challenge your comfort.
Expose your excuses.
And call you into real obedience.
🔥 INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU’LL DISCOVER:

• Why faith without action is spiritually dangerous
• The hidden reason you keep delaying obedience
• How to break out of passive Christianity
• What real biblical faith actually looks like
• Why grace empowers obedience—not excuses sin
• How to move when God speaks (even when it’s uncomfortable)
⚔️ THIS IS WHERE MOST PEOPLE GET EXPOSED

Most people say “I believe in God”
Few actually obey Him

Most people wait for the perfect moment
Few move when God says “now”

Most people want blessings
Few want surrender

Most people stay comfortable
Few step out of the boat
Which one are you?
🔒 THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE
This book is NOT public.
This is a growing movement of believers who are done with:

• Lukewarm faith
• Excuses and delay
• Empty Christianity
• Spiritual inconsistency
And are serious about:

• Obedience
• Discipline
• Real transformation
• Following Jesus for real
⚡ THIS IS YOUR MOMENT

If you feel convicted right now…
that’s not pressure.
That’s God calling you higher.

Stop waiting.
Stop delaying.
Stop pretending.
Step into a faith that actually moves.
